description.zh: 工单附件Key，补充当前工单信息。可通过调用[GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The key of the attachment that provides more instructions for the ticket. You can call the [GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~) operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of the AttachmentKey parameter.

description.zh: 业务背景，以减少沟通成本。
description.en: The purpose or objective of the data change. This parameter is used to help reduce unnecessary communication.

description.zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见[指定API调用者](~~2835451~~)。</props>
description.en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the user who actually invokes the API.<props="china">For more information, see [Specify an API caller](~~2835451~~).</props>

The stakeholders of the data change. All stakeholders can view the ticket details and assist in the approval process. Irrelevant users other than DMS administrators and database administrators (DBAs) are not allowed to view the ticket details.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

descriptions.zh:
- 目前仅支持管控模式为安全协同的实例调用该API。更多信息，请参见[无锁数据变更](~~96145~~)、[无锁结构变更](~~98373~~)。
- 成功调用CreateFreeLockCorrectOrder后，还需要调用[SubmitOrderApproval](~~465869~~)接口提交工单审批、[ApproveOrder](~~465870~~)接口审批工单以及[ExecuteDataCorrect](~~466296~~)接口执行数据变更。
descriptions.en:
- This API supports only instances whose control mode is Security Collaboration. For more information, see [Lockless Data Change](~~96145~~) and [Lockless Schema Evolution](~~98373~~).
- After successfully invoking CreateFreeLockCorrectOrder, you must also invoke the [SubmitOrderApproval](~~465869~~) API to submit the ticket for approval, the [ApproveOrder](~~465870~~) API to approve the ticket, and the [ExecuteDataCorrect](~~466296~~) API to execute the data change.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-free-lock-correct-order --comment test --related-user-list 510000 --param '{"Classify":"test","AttachmentName":"test.sql","DbItemList":[{"DbId":18600000,"Logic":false}],"RollbackSqlType":"TEXT","SqlType":"TEXT","ExecMode":"COMMITOR","ExecSQL":"delete_from_base_user_where_1_=_1","RollbackAttachmentName":"test_rollback.sql","RollbackSQL":"empty"}' --attachment-key order_attachment.txt --tid 3000 --real-login-user-uid 214004479568670000 --region cn-hangzhou
